description: Lists AI solution task IDs, slugs, descriptions and company coverage, optionally within an industry. An optional query filters the directory. Ambiguous 'AI verification platform', 'verification' and 'verify' queries include clarification_required with identities/KYC, document authenticity and factual-claim choices; these have no selected meaning. Company coverage overlaps across tasks, so task counts are not additive distinct-company totals.

limit.description: Requested number of individual result rows (1–50): top 2 corresponds to limit 2. Also the page size for continuation requests.

offset.description: Row offset. Use nextOffset from the previous response.

name: list_tasks
title: Map AI tasks to IDs
